academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2026-27; reviewed on 2026-08-24
note: The official CUHK Undergraduate Student Handbook Science Faculty Package applies to students admitted in 2026-27 and publishes 19 Science code-title-unit rows across Life Sciences, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics and Statistics. Its 111,950-byte rendered document body had SHA-256 354c657ab1830edf11e52ea73e51e87de70af03495d4231a11361bc64aade390. Every listed course carries 3 units. The Science requirement explicitly permits Risk Management Science students to use one of DOTE1031, DOTE1040, HTMG1010 or MGNT1020 from the Business Administration Faculty Package; the current official Business Package document supplies those four titles and 3-unit values, and its 28,482-byte rendered body had SHA-256 698aa21751188f8dc145bc88ee5c2f41d47a9c64177af3ec1ee2bdce3d014eb7. The Faculty page states that broad-based students take at least three Faculty Package courses according to their desired Major and cross-group rules, while its FAQ explains that the courses are not formally confined to Year 1. The complete visually reviewed 19-page Science undergraduate brochure was 10,447,082 bytes with SHA-256 9ad63621cfcf66783d25f7f8557f0408be9c08c2ce7396292ce729e04bb8112a and confirms that students explore before declaring a Major. Because the aggregate BSCIN route branches into separate Major Programmes with different requirements, only the complete 23-course Faculty Package scope is exposed for browse-only planning with totalCreditRequired=0 and no graduation completion percentage; destination-Major curricula are not copied into this aggregate Programme.
